steps.text: Portal needs HDR off on this engine, same as Portal 2: Source's HDR path triggers a MoltenVK bug that kills map loads. This recipe writes mat_hdr_level 0 into the game's config; with it the opening vault runs at ~96 fps under DXVK. Keep the bottle on DXVK. Visual cost is Source's HDR bloom only.

knownIssues.symptom: Freeze or crash at the end of map loads with HDR enabled
knownIssues.cause: Source's HDR path emits a zero-attachment render pass that aborts the Apple GPU inside MoltenVK (same root cause as Portal 2)
knownIssues.fix: mat_hdr_level 0 via this recipe's autoexec.cfg — verified device-clean

lastVerified.result: First chamber renders at ~96 fps, 1728x1117, DXVK + async, HDR off via autoexec only (cfg persistence verified, no launch options). Zero device loss.
